metric_definitions.max_consecutive_same_action: max run-length of identical consecutive actions in the sequence
metric_definitions.max_consecutive_same_observation: max run-length of identical observation_after strings
metric_definitions.state_action_pair_repeat_count: number of (observation_after[t-1] or obs_before[t], action[t]) pairs that occur at least twice in the episode
metric_definitions.state_action_loop_occurrences: total occurrences beyond the first of every repeated (state, action) pair = sum_{pairs with count>1} (count-1)
metric_definitions.no_new_info_action_ratio: fraction of steps where observation_after == observation_before (environment returned identical text)
metric_definitions.obs_change_after_action_ratio: fraction of steps where observation_after != previous observation_after
metric_definitions.unique_location_visit_count: number of distinct ALFWorld location tokens observed as current place (desk/shelf/bed/drawer/...)
metric_definitions.half_behavior_divergence: 1 - Jaccard(first_half_action_multiset_keys, second_half_action_multiset_keys) using action identity (not counts); 0 = identical action sets
